messages.subject: shinysky jstree classes and depths for nodes
parts:
In case anybody else needs to tag nodes with id, class, and/or depth info,
I modified jstree.obj().
Pull request is pending for a while, that's why I'm posting here.

https://github.com/AnalytixWare/ShinySky/pull/6

I figured out how to attach depth-specific icons.
The obvious approaches did not work.
So if you're interested, e-mail me.

I'm working on a map between nodes and the R objects they should point to.
That should greatly increase the capability of the shinysky jstree implementation:
editing the node should change the original object.

Which, by the way, is TERRIFIC!! Thank you, Xiaodaigh.
I learned so much studying your code.

-Roger
